device_template.name: Huawei LUNA2000 battery (via SUN2000)
device_template.model: LUNA2000 behind a SUN2000 hybrid inverter
device_template.author: Stefan Maldaianu
device_template.description: The LUNA2000 battery a Huawei SUN2000 hybrid inverter manages, served by the INVERTER: the storage aggregate block at 37758-37787 (rated capacity, SOC, running status, bus voltage and current, charge/discharge power, total and daily charged/discharged energy) carries the canonical names; battery unit 1 at 37000-37025 (status, power, bus voltage, SOC, working mode, rated powers, fault ID, temperature, remaining time) and the maximum charge/discharge power (37046/37048) are diagnostics. Add it as a further device on the same connection and unit ID as the huawei_sun2000 device, only where the site has a LUNA2000. Sign: Huawei reports + while charging, which is already the gateway's battery_power/battery_current convention: nothing is inverted. Read-only: no working-mode or charge command. Field notes: enable Modbus TCP on the SDongle in FusionSolar (Dongle parameters -> Modbus TCP -> Enable unrestricted); unit ID = the inverter's RS485 address (usually 1); the dongle serves ONE Modbus client only, so keep a single gateway connection and poll every 10-30 s; port 502 on the SDongle, 6607 on the inverter's own WLAN access point; Modbus RTU direct on the inverter's RS485 is 9600 8N1. The inverter is the master of its RS485 bus to the DTSU666 meter: never add a second master there, use the listen-only rtu_tap mode to watch it. SunSpec (40000) is a quick alternative without battery, meter or alarms.
device_template.source_document: Huawei 'Solar Inverter Modbus Interface Definitions', energy storage registers 37000-37048 and 37758-37787; cross-read against wlcrs/huawei-solar-lib (storage_* and storage_unit_1_* definitions). Not yet checked on hardware.

notes.text: Not yet checked on hardware: compare SOC and power with FusionSolar; battery_power must be positive while the battery charges.
Without a LUNA2000 the inverter answers 0 or 'illegal data address' here; do not add this device then. Same connection as the inverter: the SDongle takes one client.
The maximum charge/discharge power (37046/37048) sits in a read of its own; if this firmware refuses it, list 37046-37049 in the device's illegal registers.
